comparison: mixed model minus same-seed protein-only GQ2048; same48 protein development systems and192 paired forecasts
decision: Do not merge balanced mixture as a general-purpose improvement. Joint gains on complex validation do not transfer without cost: protein bond/angle geometry and clashes regress in both seeds, and seed72 RMSF also worsens. Atom71 incurs smaller geometric regression while improving primary motion errors; await atom72 before choosing a compromise.
ongoing_experiments: Shared-observation geometry and main-static curriculum use fixed balanced parents/settings and remain prospective repair tests; their parent is no longer described as a globally improved model. They must recover protein retention as well as ligand geometry and motion.
interpretation_limit: Balanced versus GQ changes data exposure and role weights. The larger regression versus atom71 is suggestive, not yet the complete two-seed isolated role-weight comparison. Do not infer a mechanism from aggregate scores alone.
limitations: Marginal bootstrap intervals without multiplicity correction
RMSF amplitude-ratio changes have no universal lower-is-better direction
No equilibrium or long-time kinetic claim
